about: The historical runs the result cache may serve (spec §11). Each entry was computed and checked by python -m etf_risk.runs register, written with Claude Code (Opus 5.5), and approved by the project author on the date it gives. The digest is checked again before every use.

runs.note: One of the four runs of the rolling-252-s21-r2 protocol. The documented run of record is run-20261013T043848Z-2; plots.py states that the four runs have identical tables. This run is the only one of the four with a verify.json.
